decisions.reason: It is tightly related to the firm's core recycling-systems knowledge and the reported customer saving of more than €600,000 per year gives strong early evidence that the firm can learn from and commercially refine it rather than withdraw it.

A mobile slow-speed shredder fits the firm's established mobile processing and service capabilities, and although market evidence is thinner than for A, the firm's absorptive capacity and growing industry context favor further improvement over discontinuation.

As a flagship modular product line in the firm's stated strategic direction, it builds directly on existing environmental-technology and modular-system expertise, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

A mobile trommel screen is close to the firm's existing application, maintenance and support knowledge base, so in a growing firm and market it is more likely to be incrementally developed than taken off the market.
